dct_description_sm:
The Annual Programming of Authorized Harvesting Activities (PRANA) is developed based on the intervention sectors of the Operational Integrated Forest Management Plan (PAFIO) and respects the Tactical Management Plan Strategy (PAFIT).

PRANA presents the areas of intervention authorized by the Ministry in which right holders will be able to carry out forest management activities over the course of a year. It aims to generate the expected volumes of wood while respecting the agreed harmonization measures.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
